summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. containing the final detailed voting map (consolidated vote results) from its Ordinary General Meeting held on April 29, 2026, as required under Brazilian CVM Resolution. The matters voted were routine agenda items (Items 1-4). This is a routine meeting reporting document, not a special situation. No deal terms, no acquisition/divestiture, no management changes, no strategic review. The map lists shareholders by partial CPF/CNPJ and their vote preferences on each item, classified as For, Against, or Abstain. No event-driven or corporate action beyond standard governance is present.
